A2/LightGBM yang dilatih hanya pada PhiUSIIL mencapai F1 0,599064, FPR benign 0,986478, ROC-AUC 0,382566, dan MCC −0,146445 pada 168.035 URL PhreshPhish, dibandingkan F1 sumber 0,995985. detail: English abstract: bounded saturation, prior test inspection and E8 uncertainty; preserved supported metrics and evaluative novelty.
before: We test whether near-perfect phishing URL detection on PhiUSIIL persists when the splitting unit, time, and corpus change. The design combines a label-recoverability audit, random and site-disjoint splits, feature-group ablation, within-corpus temporal evaluation on PhreshPhish, frozen A2 zero-shot cross-corpus transfer, validation-only threshold selection, and empirical error taxonomy. On PhiUSIIL, A0/LightGBM reached F1 0.999623 under site-disjoint splitting, while two retained features individually had AUC above 0.988, indicating a corpus-level ceiling effect. Within PhreshPhish, temporal A2/LightGBM achieved mean F1 0.800461. In contrast, A2/LightGBM trained only on PhiUSIIL obtained F1 0.599064, benign FPR 0.986478, ROC-AUC 0.382566, and MCC −0.146445 when transferred zero-shot to 168,035 PhreshPhish URLs, despite source-domain F1 0.995985. Because the extractor, feature order, model, and 0.5 threshold were frozen without target adaptation, this experiment establishes failed cross-corpus portability for the tested dataset pair, not a specific temporal cause. In a separate PhreshPhish temporal refit, a threshold of 0.884705 selected to satisfy validation FPR ≤1% produced test FPR 1.1352% and recall 0.5440, versus test FPR 7.6497% and recall 0.7380 at threshold 0.5. Error analysis found 37.1% of all false negatives on hosting-platform domains, while benign URLs of length ≤30 had FPR 21.8%; these category findings are descriptive and confounded. The contribution is an auditable evidence chain separating benchmark saturation, temporal evaluation, cross-corpus transfer, and operational consequences without claiming a new model or state of the art.
after: We examine how phishing URL detection results vary across split unit, time, and corpus using two phishing-URL datasets. The study combines a label-recoverability audit, random and site-disjoint splits, grouped feature ablation, within-corpus temporal evaluation on PhreshPhish, frozen A2 zero-shot transfer, validation-only threshold selection, and descriptive error analysis. On PhiUSIIL, A0/LightGBM achieved site-disjoint F1 0.999623; two retained features each had single-feature AUC above 0.988, consistent with descriptive benchmark saturation but not identifying its cause. PhreshPhish temporal A2/LightGBM achieved mean F1 0.800461. A2/LightGBM trained only on PhiUSIIL achieved F1 0.599064, benign FPR 0.986478, ROC-AUC 0.382566, and MCC −0.146445 on 168,035 PhreshPhish URLs, compared with source-domain F1 0.995985. These results describe portability on the tested pair and do not identify a temporal cause. The temporal test partition had previously been inspected in exploratory work and was not a blind or prospective holdout. In a separate temporal refit, threshold 0.884705 selected to meet validation FPR ≤1% yielded test FPR 1.1352% and recall 0.5440, compared with 7.6497% and 0.7380 at threshold 0.5. Error analysis found 37.1% of all false negatives in the hosting-platform category and 21.8% FPR among benign URLs ≤30 characters; these overlapping categories are descriptive, and platform-cluster uncertainty was not verified. The contribution is an auditable comparison of benchmark saturation, temporal evaluation, one-direction cross-corpus transfer, threshold trade-offs, and descriptive error patterns, not a new model or state-of-the-art claim.

detail: Corrected current metric semantics and excluded benign-positive E3 metrics from phishing-positive interpretation.

after: Untuk analisis E5–E8 saat ini, label dipetakan menjadi legitim=0 dan phishing=1; phishing adalah kelas positif, dan FPR benign dihitung terhadap kelas legitim. detail: Reframed retained high-AUC fields as observed separability, not proven label proxies or a causal ceiling mechanism.
before: Keputusan penyaringan yang dilaporkan artikel ini berbeda dari kesan yang mungkin timbul dari daftar "kolom ber-AUC tinggi dibuang". URLSimilarityIndex dibuang, tetapi LineOfCode dan NoOfExternalRef tetap berada di dalam A0. Artinya, konfigurasi acuan 47 fitur masih memuat dua kolom yang secara tunggal hampir menyelesaikan tugas klasifikasi. Konsekuensi metodologisnya penting: plafon F1 sebesar 0,9996–0,9998 yang dilaporkan pada Bagian 3.2 tidak dapat diatribusikan sepenuhnya kepada kapasitas model. Sebagian plafon tersebut adalah properti korpus, dan audit ini menempatkannya secara eksplisit.
after: Implementasi menghapus URLSimilarityIndex tetapi mempertahankan LineOfCode dan NoOfExternalRef dalam A0. Dengan demikian, konfigurasi acuan 47 fitur memuat dua kolom dengan AUC tunggal di atas 0,988, yang menunjukkan separabilitas tinggi pada korpus berlabel. Hal ini tidak menunjukkan bahwa salah satu kolom diturunkan dari label atau menyebabkan hasil model yang mendekati plafon. Nilai F1 0,9996–0,9998 adalah hasil benchmark yang teramati; bukti yang tersedia tidak memisahkan kontribusi pemodelan, nilai fitur tersimpan, label sumber, maupun proses pengumpulan data.

after: Audit domain menemukan 175.509 registrable domain unik dan 636 baris alamat IP. Nilai registrable domain berulang terdapat pada 62,0 % baris phishing dan 2,6 % baris legitim. Di luar 22 berkas terdaftar, terdapat dua item tidak terdaftar di direktori: berkas ulasan terdahulu dan arsip ZIP cermin. Dataset sumber tidak didistribusikan ulang dan tetap tunduk pada lisensi masing-masing. Artefak ruang kerja penulis berada di lokasi terpisah dan bukan bagian dari paket tinjauan ini.
